name: Bronze-featherback cake
summary: A fish cake from Lak Lake, fried golden. Bao Dak Lak says pepper and fish sauce are enough. This is Lak, not the city afternoon bowl. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Bao Dak Lak on 10 Feb 2021 calls chả cá thát lát the taste people remember from Lak district.
howToEat: An elder beside Lak Lake, quoted that day, ties the fish to water and food from the Chu Yang Sin headwaters. The cake needs no seasoning beyond a little pepper and fish sauce, and is then crisp and naturally sweet. Fried golden and set on a plate with a few dill stems. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Lak Lake, in Lak district. A stall and the drive minutes from Buon Ma Thuot are Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Cha ca that lat — fish cake at Lak Lake
seoDescription: Bronze-featherback cake at Lak, fried golden, with pepper and fish sauce. A stall and a price are Check on arrival.
taste: Bao Dak Lak on 10 Feb 2021 calls the cake crisp and naturally sweet.
